decision.observation: 7 mph, gear 1, four dots lit, no red X. The camera has settled behind the car: the Nimkäädel gate spans the lane directly ahead, the car sits inside the opening roughly 5-6 m short of the arch, only slightly right of centre, with the lane running up through the gate and green light washing the posts. Lane edge and white markers are left of the car.
decision.hypothesis: The car is now lined up inside the gate opening and not aimed at either pillar. Straight throttle should carry it under the arch and onto the lane beyond, without needing a steer that would scrub speed.
decision.memory: Earlier pin at the arch came from approaching the right pillar from off-lane; from this centred approach straight W has clearance. Hold off steering until the car is through and the lane's bend past the gate is visible.
